item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); expected=json.load(open('report.json')); actual=[evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; assert actual==expected; print('report verified')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"from work import evaluate\\np={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}\\ncases=[({'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''},'error':None}),({'layers':[{'i':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'},'error':None}),({'layers':[{'z':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),({'environment':{'b':'false','i':'-0','s':''}},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''},'error':None}),({'environment':{'b':'False'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),({'environment':{'i':'+1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),({'environment':{'i':' 1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),({'environment':{'i':'1.0'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),({'layers':[{'i':True}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'})]\\nfor req,want in cases: assert evaluate(req,p)==want,(req,evaluate(req,p),want)\\np2=dict(p,environment=False)\\nassert evaluate({'environment':{'i':'1'}},p2)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}\\np3=dict(p,null_resets=False)\\nassert evaluate({'layers':[{'s':None}]},p3)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}\\nprint('edge cases verified')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--check\"]}}]}"}
